periodic_evaluation.schedule: round 0, every eval_interval completed updates, and the final update
periodic_evaluation.action_selection: deterministic argmax; fresh environments; no training samples
periodic_evaluation.aggregation: arithmetic mean of all three complete windows; null metrics if any window fails
periodic_evaluation.violation_rate_definition: violating active reservoir-days / all active reservoir-days; counts pooled over all three complete windows; undiscounted; null if a window fails or no requirement is active
periodic_evaluation.role: fixed training-only convergence diagnostics; held-out years are reserved for final evaluation

calendar: fixed consecutive daily steps with leap days retained; storage carries across source-year boundaries
daily_bound_alignment: action_date=t constrains the state after action t; no additional date shift

step_logging.record_scope: one row per environment day; scalar team metrics over all five reservoirs
step_logging.daily_reward_discounting: undiscounted; apply gamma**(episode_step-1) for episode totals
step_logging.shortfall_aggregation: physical deficits are summed over the five reservoirs; penalties retain reward weights and means
step_logging.missing_service_values: empty CSV cells; known zero deficits are written as 0
step_logging.float_precision: 10 significant digits in CSV only; internal calculations retain full precision
step_logging.output: one CSV per seed; JSONL contains summaries and configuration

evaluation: held-out representative years in configured order; storage carries across boundaries; one sequence scored after training, without policy ranking

violation_rate_aggregation: sum counts / sum active reservoir-days across all three complete windows; null when any window fails or the denominator is zero
